items.label: Mayor's Resignation Video

items.description: Screenshot of the viral post's comment section. 15,000 reactions in 4 hours. Several accounts pushing the resignation narrative were created recently.

items.description: Server access logs showing the video's upload origin. IP address resolves to a VPN registered to VeraTech Solutions — a shell company linked to coordinated disinformation operations.
